goal: 设计一种降低社区自行车维修预约爽约的服务流程。
hard_constraints: 两名志愿者每周只开两个半天，不购买短信服务。
不得公开顾客姓名或把未到者列入黑名单。
比较原先单次预约流程，记录等待时间、空档和误取消。
available_resources: 纸质预约簿、电话和候补名单。
expected_result: 可选参加且容易执行的小规模试行。

goal: Create a way to reduce peak-hour waiting at a small bakery without adding staff or making rushed orders more error-prone.
hard_constraints: Two staff handle counter, packing and payment in a 90-minute peak.
No paid kiosk, app requirement or advance customer data collection.
Observe queue time and order errors against the present single line.
available_resources: Paper signs, tickets and one week of aggregate hourly counts.
expected_result: A workable service mechanism and small test.

goal: 提高社区工具库的共享工具借还周转，同时兼顾遗失风险和低数字能力使用者。
hard_constraints: 每周只开放三次，只有一名值班员。
现有借阅卡必须保留；不能要求手机或押金上涨。
区分借出率、可用率、逾期和维修负担。
available_resources: 纸卡、工具状态标签和四周借阅记录。
expected_result: 可执行借还机制与公平性检查。

goal: Reduce wrong-item handoffs in a four-person craft shop that takes custom orders by phone and at the counter.
hard_constraints: No new software purchase or extra shift; the shop must keep taking same-day orders.
Customers may change orders once; revisions must not silently overwrite earlier instructions.
Measure mismatch, added service time and correction burden over two weeks.
available_resources: Existing paper tickets, receipt printer and two staff check-ins daily.
expected_result: A traceable order handoff design with a failure path.

goal: 为小型花店的季节性滞销库存找可持续用途，不能靠虚报折扣或增加大量处理劳动。
hard_constraints: 店内冷藏空间固定，每日最多半小时额外整理。
不得把不新鲜花材冒充原价新品。
比较废弃量、毛利、员工时间和顾客投诉。
available_resources: 原有店面、纸质标牌和历史日销量。
expected_result: 两周试点及清晰取舍。

goal: Help first-time visitors use a walk-in neighborhood legal-information desk without making them disclose private details in the waiting area.
hard_constraints: Two volunteers have one desk and printed public information; they do not give legal advice.
No app, registration requirement or public triage of personal cases.
Check successful navigation, waiting confusion and privacy complaints.
available_resources: Existing opening hours, printed service scope and a quiet corner.
expected_result: An inclusive first-visit flow with escalation to qualified help.

goal: 减少跨时区小团队的交接遗漏，同时避免每天增加长会议。
hard_constraints: 六人分布三个时区，每人每天只允许十分钟额外交接。
不能要求所有人同时在线；客户敏感信息不可复制到公开板。
试点要衡量遗漏、重复工作与记录负担。
available_resources: 现有私有任务板和交接记录。
expected_result: 明确的责任转移机制与试行。

goal: Make decisions from a weekly volunteer committee meeting turn into completed actions without making the chair a permanent bottleneck.
hard_constraints: Eight volunteers meet for 45 minutes; no paid project software.
Actions need owners and due dates but members can decline tasks.
Compare completion, rework and volunteer burden over one month.
available_resources: Shared notes and a basic calendar.
expected_result: A lightweight decision-to-action mechanism.

goal: 让资深维修员的隐性诊断经验传给新成员，而不靠无限录像或让资深员全天答疑。
hard_constraints: 两位资深员每周最多各一小时；四位新人照常工作。
不能在客户设备上做不安全试验。
区分新人判断改进、资深员负担和错误自信。
available_resources: 已匿名的工单与可离线演示的报废设备。
expected_result: 实践传承方式及可观测验证。

goal: Stabilize a community kitchen's volunteer rota when availability changes at short notice.
hard_constraints: There are 20 volunteers, two essential roles per shift, and no new paid coordinator.
Never pressure someone to disclose health or family reasons for absence.
Measure uncovered shifts, last-minute messages and fairness of unpopular shifts.
available_resources: Existing roster spreadsheet and a telephone tree.
expected_result: A resilient scheduling mechanism with a missed-shift fallback.

goal: 协调产品与客服对一项功能需求的冲突，在两周内形成可复查的取舍决定。
hard_constraints: 双方各两人，不能新增客户访谈或改现有合同承诺。
必须写清两方各自证据及不确定处，不可用职位高低代替判断。
给出决策后何种信号触发重审。
available_resources: 现有客服票据、使用统计汇总和开发估时。
expected_result: 公平的需求取舍流程与最小试验。

goal: Help new members of a research lab ask for help early without flooding a single senior researcher.
hard_constraints: Five new and three senior members; each senior has at most 20 minutes weekly for this process.
No public display of individual mistakes or mandatory personal disclosures.
Assess time to useful help, repeated blockers and senior load.
available_resources: Existing private chat and weekly lab meeting.
expected_result: A sustainable help-seeking mechanism and pilot.

goal: 探索同批盆栽幼苗生长差异的几种可能解释，并设计可区分它们的低风险观察。
hard_constraints: 只有二十盆、两周、尺子和同一温室角落。
不得破坏植株或声称已找到原因。
考虑初始大小、浇水和位置差异，允许结果不确定。
available_resources: 日常浇水记录与可交换盆位。
expected_result: 替代假设、观测顺序及反证条件。

goal: Investigate why a paper-based package becomes damp in storage using safe bench observations rather than assuming the new coating failed.
hard_constraints: Ten sample packages, humidity logger and one week; no hazardous chemicals or customer shipments.
Distinguish ambient humidity, condensation and package material effects.
Do not claim causal proof from a single uncontrolled comparison.
available_resources: A dry cabinet and ordinary room storage.
expected_result: Competing explanations and bounded discriminating tests.

goal: 解释合成数据里两个指标突然反向相关的可能原因，并设计不泄露原始个体数据的排查。
hard_constraints: 只有去标识化汇总表和生成脚本的只读副本。
不得把相关当因果，不能假定代码错误。
至少考虑分组混合、时间趋势和测量定义改变，记录何时仍无法区分。
available_resources: 可重跑的小型合成样例和版本日志。
expected_result: 可执行假设检查与不确定性说明。

goal: Determine whether a classroom light meter's apparent afternoon drift is due to the meter, changing daylight or placement.
hard_constraints: One meter, two rooms, five school days and no electrical modifications.
Measurements cannot interrupt lessons; log time, orientation and weather proxy.
Allow inconclusive findings and state what a control comparison can and cannot establish.
available_resources: Window shade, fixed lamp and written observation sheets.
expected_result: Safe discriminating measurement plan.

goal: 调查社区鸟类观察记录减少的非因果解释，不把记录下降直接说成鸟类减少。
hard_constraints: 只能使用过去一年公开汇总记录及志愿者出勤表，不开展捕捉或干预动物。
考虑观察努力、季节和记录方式改变。
不虚构种群数字，提出下一步可证伪的观察。
available_resources: 固定路线与旧记录表。
expected_result: 替代解释和谨慎报告模板。

goal: Explore why a clap seems quieter at different positions in an empty hallway without installing equipment or exposing anyone to loud sound.
hard_constraints: A group has one afternoon, a phone sound meter used only for aggregate level, and a tape measure.
No recordings of voices, hazardous volume or blocking the hallway.
Consider distance, reflections and background noise; no claim of calibrated acoustics.
available_resources: Several safe standing points and a quiet baseline period.
expected_result: Distinct explanations and an observable comparison.

goal: 把复杂的社区厨房开门与清洁流程压成一页说明，让新志愿者能正确执行关键步骤。
hard_constraints: 只可用A4双面黑白打印，不增加培训时长。
食品安全步骤不可省略或颠倒。
用新手模拟找出漏步与误解，而非只问是否好看。
available_resources: 现有操作手册和两名新志愿者试读。
expected_result: 具体的信息组织机制及验证。

goal: Explain the abstract idea of feedback loops to mixed-age museum visitors in several meaningfully different ways.
hard_constraints: A tabletop exhibit has 90 seconds of visitor attention, paper and simple movable pieces only.
Do not imply every feedback loop is harmful or that a single example proves a general rule.
Check understanding on a new example, including a visitor who prefers text over manipulation.
available_resources: One curator and two prototype sessions.
expected_result: An explanation structure and transfer check.

goal: 设计一支无旁白的九十秒短片，讲清一件旧物从弃置到修复的过程而不伪造历史。
hard_constraints: 只可拍现有物件与真实修复步骤，无演员、字幕可用但总字数有限。
不能隐瞒修复失败或把未知来源拍成确定故事。
比较观众对关键步骤的理解，而非只看喜欢程度。
available_resources: 手机摄影、简单剪辑和一名修复志愿者。
expected_result: 可拍摄的叙事结构与试映检查。

goal: Improve wayfinding in a small multilingual public clinic without relying on reading long translated paragraphs.
hard_constraints: Four languages are common; only existing walls and paper signs can be used.
Emergency and private-care routes must not be confused; no collection of patient destinations.
Test first-time navigation and wrong turns with consent and no health disclosure.
available_resources: Current floor plan and volunteer observers.
expected_result: A robust sign hierarchy and test.

goal: 为资料不完整的地方档案展设计不同叙事组织，让观众知道什么有证据、什么仍未知。
hard_constraints: 四个展柜和已有档案复印件，不能补造历史事实。
文字须适合短暂停留和坐着观看。
小试要比较观众能否区分记录、推测与空白。
available_resources: 现有日期清单、照片和口述授权摘录。
expected_result: 具体展线与理解检查。

goal: Communicate a community center's energy-saving options without fear tactics, misleading savings numbers or assuming everyone controls the building.
hard_constraints: One printed poster and take-home card; no app or personalized usage data.
Separate actions available to visitors from those only staff can take.
Check whether readers identify one feasible action and understand uncertainty in any savings estimate.
available_resources: Existing building policies and verified aggregate energy figures.
expected_result: An honest communication mechanism and critique.

goal: 设计合租房公共用品的分摊方式，让购买者不用一直垫钱，也不造成公开羞辱。
hard_constraints: 四名室友，只有纸笔和共享储物柜；不要求绑定支付应用。
个人用品与公共用品要可区分，任何人可提出退出。
试行应观察缺货、争议和记账负担。
available_resources: 原有采购小票和每周十分钟讨论。
expected_result: 可协商的分摊机制。

goal: Make a 20-square-meter room support both remote work and exercise without buying major furniture.
hard_constraints: One person has a foldable desk, mat and limited storage; no drilling or electrical rewiring.
Keep a clear exit path and avoid daily setup taking more than ten minutes.
Compare usable floor area, switching effort and clutter over one week.
available_resources: Existing shelves, boxes and a tape measure.
expected_result: A practical space-switching design.

goal: 协调作息不同的三名家人做家务，减少吵醒他人和总由一人补漏。
hard_constraints: 不能要求所有人同一时间开会或用手机应用。
噪声较大的任务限白天，私人作息不公开展示。
两周观察完成率、公平感与提醒负担。
available_resources: 冰箱门磁贴和每周短谈。
expected_result: 低冲突的任务分配与补位机制。

goal: Help a two-person household waste less fresh food when work schedules change unpredictably.
hard_constraints: No new appliance, food tracking app or assumption of daily shopping.
Respect food safety dates and do not recommend eating spoiled food.
Compare discarded food, meal flexibility and planning time over three weeks.
available_resources: Existing fridge, freezer and paper notes.
expected_result: A resilient food-use routine.

goal: 减少出门忘带钥匙、证件等重要物品，但不依赖会发声的设备。
hard_constraints: 预算只够购买少量收纳物，不安装门锁或摄像头。
不能把证件长期放在门外可见处。
评估遗漏次数、误报提醒和每天额外动作。
available_resources: 玄关小桌与常用背包。
expected_result: 可持续的物品检查机制。

goal: Make important paper documents retrievable within five minutes in a crowded shared home without exposing private papers to other residents.
hard_constraints: No scanning service or new lockable cabinet; each adult controls their own documents.
A common label system must not reveal document contents.
Test retrieval time, misfiling and upkeep after four weeks.
available_resources: Folders, envelopes and one shared shelf.
expected_result: A privacy-respecting paper retrieval system.

goal: 把社区中心的雨天小型户外活动改编为仍可参与的活动，不让室内空间超员。
hard_constraints: 十五名参与者、两名志愿者，室内房间额定八人。
不可把行动不便者留在雨中或强迫在线参加。
提前一天决定方案，并检查参与率、安全和志愿者负担。
available_resources: 有顶棚走廊、纸质材料和预约房间。
expected_result: 安全的弹性活动机制。

goal: Improve access to a one-day neighborhood workshop in a temporary hall with uneven entrances.
hard_constraints: Three volunteers, one week, removable signs and portable chairs; no structural alterations.
Do not advertise an entrance as accessible until its route is checked.
Measure arrival success, waiting and dignified participation including seated options.
available_resources: Hall plan and a pre-event route inspection.
expected_result: An accessible arrival and activity layout.

goal: 让公园同一片开放草地被不同年龄与活动者共享，降低冲突但不设排他预约。
hard_constraints: 公园方只允许临时标牌和观察，不新增围栏。
不能把某年龄群默认赶走，保留通行与安静休息。
比较冲突、使用多样性与维护负担。
available_resources: 现有路径图和两周志愿观察。
expected_result: 可协商的空间共享机制。

goal: Design a neighborhood exchange of used household items that stays useful without becoming an unmonitored dumping site.
hard_constraints: Two volunteers have a covered public table for four Saturdays and no storage room.
No collection of participant names, money or hazardous electronics.
Track reuse, leftovers, cleanup time and exclusion of people who cannot lift heavy items.
available_resources: Printed item tags and a municipal disposal guide.
expected_result: A practical exchange flow with leftovers handled.

goal: 减少快闪手工活动结束时狭窄出口的拥堵，又不延长场地租用时间。
hard_constraints: 一百人、一个出口、四名志愿者，消防通道不能挪作排队区。
不能强制按购买金额或身份优先离场。
用可观察的离场时间、拥堵点与参与者困惑评价。
available_resources: 场地图、纸质提示和十分钟收尾时段。
expected_result: 安全公平的散场流程。

goal: Keep an unattended reading corner in a public waiting room tidy and welcoming without turning volunteers into full-time monitors.
hard_constraints: One shelf, donated books and two 15-minute volunteer visits per week.
No camera, user registration, fines or public naming of borrowers.
Check availability, condition, cleanup effort and access for seated readers.
available_resources: Printable shelf guides and a nearby return box.
expected_result: A self-maintaining borrowing ritual and small pilot.
